summary: This bill expands an existing grant program under the Violence Against Women Act Reauthorization Act of 2022 to include identity theft alongside cybercrimes against individuals, allowing local law enforcement to receive funding for enforcing laws related to identity theft.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Violence Against Women Act Reauthorization Act to include identity theft in a grant program for local law enforcement to enforce cybercrimes. This expands the scope of crimes that can be addressed through these grants, leading to potentially stricter enforcement against identity theft, thus aligning with stricter justice and stronger policing.
